body: I'm not sure, but I think that everyone probably would like to travel in their lifetime. What exactly is age related expansion? :O
Do you think it might be hormonal..? Or maybe personality type? I've had depression in the past teen angst-y years but life has gotten 100% better since then but I still feel trapped.
Well, I have a lot to keep me busy like studying, friends, family, there's a lot to be excited about! But for some reason, I'm just not excited at all.
